dedupe_keys.name: comnap antarctic facilities list map and station catalogue

description: COMNAP, the council of the 34 national Antarctic programmes, gives public information on the facilities those programmes operate in the Antarctic Treaty area in support of science. It offers a web map of stations and their data, in which blue dots are year-round and red dots seasonal facilities, often with a photograph and a webcam link; the COMNAP Antarctic Station Catalogue, produced in August 2017 with the EU-PolarNet European Polar Infrastructures project, with information from 30 programmes on their stations; and a downloadable Antarctic Facilities List (November 2024) with geospatial data for all facilities with a status of open or temporarily closed used for science and science support, plus a list of Antarctic vessels in operation (November 2024). The data were provided by each national programme. Access is free by download (CSV) and web map; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the station catalogue dates from 2017, and the list depends on what each programme reports. Coverage is Antarctica. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response planning for remote research stations, runways and their energy, water and communication systems; the related record is the Antarctic Treaty EIA database.
